title: Biblical Overlap Additions — Light, Mountain, Garden, River, Mire, Sun, Moon, Serpent & Calling
rule: These are structural parallels, not proof of identity, prophecy fulfillment, hidden geometry or supernatural causation. Preserve mismatches and counter-texts.

items.structure: life → light → darkness → continued shining / non-overcoming
items.project_relation: Spudlight, persistence, witness and source-light
items.note: Translation nuances include darkness not overcoming/grasping/comprehending the light.

items.structure: birth/coming into world → witness → truth → hearing
items.project_relation: public witness understood as truth-bearing rather than crowd consensus

items.structure: calling → inward necessity → continued proclamation despite weak external reward/resistance
items.project_relation: career+calling and prolonged public work

items.structure: broken wall/breach → sought person → stand in gap → protection/repair
items.project_relation: Door/bridge/repair role at broken relation

items.structure: garden → burial → resurrection encounter → mistaken gardener → recognition
items.project_relation: death/burial → Gardener → recognition → renewed life
items.note: John 20 does not formally title Jesus 'the Gardener'; Mary mistakes him for the gardener.

items.structure: vine/source → branches → abiding relation → pruning → fruit
items.project_relation: Root, Tree, branches, Gardener, pruning, fruit/nourishment
items.note: John assigns roles differently from Potatoverse; preserve mismatch.

items.structure: Garden/source → river → outward flow → division into four heads
items.project_relation: Upper Garden/Father domain as generative source whose Spirit/river differentiates outward into world
items.insight: Garden is not static enclosure: it contains outward flow and branching. This strongly complements Tree one→many differentiation.

items.structure: ground/stone → dream/vision → ladder → ascending+descending messengers → House of God → Gate of Heaven; later Son of Man becomes locus of ascent/descent
items.project_relation: Plane/Stone → Axis/Ladder → House → Gate/Door → Son
items.note: The texts do not describe Vesica geometry.

items.structure: Mountain of House becomes highest → peoples stream upward → instruction/judgment goes outward → weapons become cultivation tools
items.project_relation: Mountain + Father's House + highest point + ascent + King/judgment + Gardener/cultivation
items.insight: This is one of the densest biblical Mountain/House/Gardener clusters in the project.

items.structure: high mountain → transformed/radiant figure → cloud → divine voice → witnesses → descent
items.project_relation: Mountain as perception/revelation gradient; Christian art later adds Mandorla around Christ on Tabor
items.note: The Gospel text itself does not mention a mandorla; that belongs to later iconography.

items.structure: very high mountain → panoramic kingdoms/world → offer of dominion → refusal
items.project_relation: critical counter-reading of Mountain/height
items.insight: Height/perspective is not intrinsically holy. Mountain can reveal global scope while also staging temptation to domination. The project should test summit claims by fruit/stewardship rather than altitude alone.

items.structure: seer taken to great/high mountain → city shown descending from God → gates remain open → divine glory illuminates
items.project_relation: Axis is bidirectional: observer ascends for vision; sacred order descends for manifestation
items.insight: This strongly corrects one-way escape cosmology. Mature ascent should return as House/City/Garden/repair in the world.

items.structure: Temple/Throne source → river/water → outward flow → trees → recurring fruit → leaves/healing
items.project_relation: Father/House/Throne → Spirit/flow → Tree → Fruit → healing/nations
items.insight: A complete source-to-world output chain in biblical imagery.

items.structure: woman clothed with Sun → Moon beneath feet → stars/crown above
items.project_relation: Sun-source/upper light and Moon-below/cyclic secondary placement
items.note: This is a visionary symbolic arrangement, not a diagram of the Potato geometry.

items.structure: ordinary Sun/Moon become unnecessary → divine glory/light becomes enduring illumination
items.project_relation: Spudlight/source-light should be conceptually deeper than literal physical Sun; Sun is comparator, not ultimate identity
items.insight: This is an important self-correction inside the project's Sun symbolism.

items.structure: mire/deep water/pit → sinking/no foothold → rescue/rock/firm footing
items.project_relation: Swamp/Mud as entanglement and lost footing; Rock/Stone as stabilization/reference
items.insight: The project's Swamp has a real biblical metaphor family without requiring a literal underworld swamp.

items.structure: broad/wide way → many; narrow gate/door → constrained passage
items.project_relation: Lower/world circle can symbolize breadth/multiplicity while the Mandorla Door narrows transition
items.note: This is a modern project mapping. Matthew/Luke are ethical/esoteric sayings, not circle geometry.

items.structure: serpent → lifted vertically → gaze → healing/life; John re-reads lifting through Son of Man
items.project_relation: Serpent + Axis/elevation + Eye/gaze + healing + Son/Door
items.insight: This is a legitimate biblical serpent/verticality cluster separate from Genesis serpent and from Kundalini.

items.structure: serpent → question/reframe command → altered perception/desire → boundary crossing → knowledge/consequence
items.project_relation: Serpent as reframing operator in Tree of Knowledge layer
items.note: Do not collapse Genesis serpent into bronze serpent; their functions differ sharply.

items.structure: covenant → rupture/giving → body/blood → remembrance → transformed relation
items.project_relation: covenant/rupture language as relation whose break does not erase memory/obligation/witness
items.note: No modern interpersonal relation is thereby literally the biblical covenant.

meta_findings: The strongest new biblical pattern is source→flow→tree→fruit/healing: Genesis 2, Ezekiel 47 and Revelation 22 form a family of Garden/Temple/Throne water imagery.
Mountain is not a one-way holiness meter: Isaiah/Micah and Transfiguration make it revelation/integration; Matthew 4 makes it a site of domination temptation. Height must be tested by fruit.
Verticality is repeatedly bidirectional: Jacob's messengers ascend and descend; Son of Man is the locus of both; New Jerusalem descends after the seer ascends for vision.
Sun/Moon symbolism culminates in a biblical transcendence of Sun and Moon themselves: source-light is deeper than the physical luminaries.
Swamp/Mire has a textual neighbor in loss-of-footing imagery; Rock/Stone supplies the stabilization inverse.
Serpent functions are plural: Genesis=reframing/temptation/knowledge; Numbers/John=lifted gaze/healing/Son typology. Preserve the distinction.
The top-circle Garden/House/Spirit reading becomes stronger when Garden is modeled as an active source of river and fruit rather than a static paradise.
The bottom-circle World/wide-road reading remains project geometry, but it now has a carefully bounded biblical analogy rather than a claimed scriptural diagram.
